Paying, and stopping if you want to

How to pay?

  • When you order: 25% of the website, so €125 for a €500 website.
  • When you receive the website: the rest in one go (€375), or in 6 or 12 interest-free instalments, for example €31.25 a month for 12 months. The subscription starts that day.
  • The subscription: €10 a month, or €100 a year (2 months free). You can add and remove extras whenever you like.

And if you stop?

  • You stop whenever you like: a message is enough, or the button in your client area. The subscription ends at the end of the period already paid.
  • Your domain name stays yours: it is in your name, and you can transfer it wherever you like.
  • You leave with your website: I hand over its files, text, images and pages, so you can host it elsewhere. Our hosting stops 30 days after the end of the subscription.
  • The only exception: if you pay the rest of the website in 6 or 12 instalments, you commit for the length of that payment. If you leave early, what remains of the website price is due in one go.
And compared with other solutions?Agency, freelancer, platform: the comparison, line by line. Refer a friend, and earn a monthA free month of subscription, for you and for your referred friend.

Your questions about prices

How much does it cost, all in?

€500 once for the website, then €10 a month for the subscription. The website price does not change, from one page to 10 pages. So the first year comes to €620, or €600 if you pay the subscription yearly.

What does the subscription include?

Everything that keeps your website running: the domain name, held in your name and renewed yearly, along with hosting, updates, backups and monitoring. You also get support, with an answer within 72 hours, and the basics of SEO. The guardian, a little monster from my band, watches over your website. You also enjoy the band’s small edits and tools, included as long as use stays normal. Plus one change by me every quarter. Signed up before 16 November 2026? You keep one change by me every month.

Is the subscription required?

Yes, as long as your website is online with me: it pays for the domain name, the hosting and the upkeep. But there is no commitment. You stop it whenever you like, and you keep your domain name and a copy of your website.

Who are the little monsters?

They are my automations. I programmed them one by one, then drew them as little monsters. Each one handles a repetitive but useful task, and works on its own. The basic subscription includes three: the assistant, the guardian and the handyman. The guardian looks after updates, backups, security and monitoring, and the handyman takes care of your small changes. In your client area, the writer and the messenger give you a hand every day. Each monthly option adds another one: the Google star with Google follow-up, the observer with Detailed figures, the postman with Business email address, the storekeeper with Stock management and the host with Customer accounts. I always check what they do.

What if I need more changes?

Small edits go through the band, and you can get more if you go beyond normal use. Would you like me to come back before the next quarter? From your client area, order one extra change by hand for €5. It is added to your following invoice.

Is a failed edit counted?

No. It does not count if publishing fails, if you turn down the preview or if the request comes to me. The same goes when you cancel a request within 24 hours of sending it, up to three times a month.

Who makes my changes?

It is your choice, for every request. For a small edit, the handyman, one of the little monsters in the band, prepares the change in a few minutes and shows you a preview: nothing moves on your website without your approval. The bigger ones I do by hand: one change per quarter is included, carried out within 72 hours and checked by me personally. I also keep an eye on what the band does.

Which extras can I add to the subscription?

You pay for them monthly, and you can add or drop them at any time from your client area: Google follow-up for €10, Detailed figures for €5 and Business email address for €3. Online shops can also have Stock management and Customer accounts, at €5 each. Each one adds a little monster to your band. None of them is compulsory.

What about on-demand extras?

They are paid once, only when you need them: one extra change by hand at €5, your request within 24 hours at €5, an article written and published at €15, one more page at €10, or a 30-minute catch-up together at €15. You order them yourself from your client area, and the amount is added to your next invoice. No order, nothing to pay.

And for an online shop?

It is €200 more for the build, so €700 once. The subscription stays at €10 a month. The shop includes card payment, order tracking and up to 20 products that I add for you.

Monthly or yearly?

As you like. Monthly, the subscription costs €10. Yearly, it costs €100: you pay for ten months at once and 2 are free. You can switch from one to the other at renewal.

What counts as a change?

A precise change to an existing page: opening hours, a price, a photo, a text, a product. One request, one change. My quarterly change does not carry over if you do not use it. A new page costs €10, ordered from your client area. A new feature needs a small quote.

Why is it 4 to 5 times cheaper than a website made by hand?

Because I spent a lot of time programming my little band, automations that take care of everything that repeats. I also have direct access to French hosting providers. No magic involved, just optimisation. When an agency or a freelancer makes a showcase website by hand, it generally costs between €1,500 and €3,000. With me, it is €500. You are not paying for weeks of work, yet I still design, review and test your website myself.

Are there any hidden costs?

No. The summary lists it all: the website build, the subscription, plus the options and extras you picked. On-demand extras are only charged if you order them. Nothing else.

Happy with the price?

Build your website in two minutes: the total is shown before you order.
